desc:
Finnish Car Game

Free Camera Mode: Shift + P

Car Controls:
W – Accelerate
S – Brake
A / D – Steer Left / Right
X – Handbrake
E / Q – Shift Up / Down
Shift - Clutch
T – Toggle TCS
Y – Toggle ABS
V – First-Person View
L – Toggle Lights

notice: not recommended on low-end devices
